acceptance.given_when_then: Given a signed-in user posting a price on offer, when CheckoutView handles it, then FakeStripe receives a subscription-mode session with the price, signed reference, existing customer or email, promotion codes and a success URL with literal {CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID}, and the user is redirected to the session url; anonymous POST goes to sign-in with no Stripe call; bad price, unavailable catalogue and Stripe error add messages and return; a held price goes to the subscriptions page
Given a return with session_id for a user with no customer, when BillingReturnView runs, then the customer is tied with from_checkout and synced before the redirect

Given the plans page, when rendered signed out / signed in / holding a price / with ?plan=, then each card offers sign-in with next back to the plan / a checkout form / Manage to the subscriptions page / the picked frequency selected and id anchor present, each control with its accessible name and off-site description
Given a cached catalogue, when a verified product.* or price.* webhook arrives or stripe_sync runs, then the next prices() fetches from Stripe; an unverified webhook leaves it

Given {% stripe_plans as plans %} in a project template, when rendered, then the same plans appear and sign-in returns there; a site-wide override of plan_features.html replaces that part on every card only; a project loop replaces one part on one page; without the Stripe app installed prices is None and nothing renders
Given the demo offline, when seed_demo runs and /plans/ is opened, then the demo catalogue is shown from the file cache and Plans is in the sidebar
Given Page without in_navigation, when the Account Center menu is built, then every remaining page is listed as before
